articles.title: Beyond crypto funding rates: Ethena diversifies USDe backing with $1 billion FalconX facility
articles.snippet: The warehouse facility gives Ethena another source of returns for the assets backing USDe while channeling onchain capital into overcollateralized institutional loans.

articles.title: OpenAI trails Anthropic as losses deepen and Altman pauses frontier AI training
articles.snippet: Widening losses and intensifying competition coincide with a pause in frontier reinforcement-learning training as openai strengthens its safety controls.

articles.title: FalconX, Ethena bring USDe backing assets into $1B institutional credit facility
articles.snippet: The $1 billion facility will deploy assets backing USDe into overcollateralized institutional loans, expanding Ethena’s sources of returns beyond crypto basis strategies.

articles.title: SEC regulatory proposal marks ‘important’ step forward from ‘inapt’ crypto rules: Commissioner Peirce
articles.snippet: “Crypto mom” Hester Peirce praised the SEC’s proposed crypto regime, published days after the Senate failed to pass the CLARITY Act, the US’ first comprehensive industry framework.

articles.title: Markets Confident OpenAI Releases Its Next AI Model in Weeks
articles.snippet: Traders are betting OpenAI's next frontier model lands within weeks—even after the company pumped the brakes.
